subject: [internal] Scope question — freight delay email from a customer
body:
Hey ops team,

Got an email from a customer about a freight delay on a power rack — does this go through our internal Gmail triage or is this fully Gorgias-owned now? I forwarded it to my inbox in case you want to look at the chain, but I want to confirm the routing before I respond.

Thanks,
Ops Analyst

expected_outcome.notes: Internal support-channel routing question ('does this go through internal Gmail triage or is it fully Gorgias-owned'). Drafts an internal reply pending CS Lead approval (CS Lead owns support-channel routing). The decision explicitly recognizes the underlying customer freight-delay issue belongs in the active Gorgias / Shipping CS workflow (surfaced in uncommitted_items). Role deterministic; holder resolved from the Org Chart at runtime.
